summary: The review covered the two files in scope at the commit above. It found one Medium and one Low finding.

findings.title: split() rounds every share down and keeps the remainder
findings.rootCause: split() divides the amount by the number of payees on line 54 and pays each the quotient. The remainder stays in the contract, and no function pays it out.
findings.impact: Each split leaves up to one base unit per payee in the contract. The loss is bounded by the number of payees on each call.
findings.recommendedFix: Pay the remainder to the last payee, or record it and let the payees claim it.

findings.title: release() emits no event
findings.rootCause: release() moves the held amount to the seller on line 74 and emits no event, so a release leaves no log entry.
findings.recommendedFix: Emit Released(id, seller, amount) from release().
